text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm at the library, looking for some
materials
related to racing, when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wow... what a wonderful tale. I'd love to
make a
picture book out of a story like
this...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hello, Rice. So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Hi, Bourbon. Did you need
something?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A dire issue has come up—it
threatens to
exploit my vulnerabilities.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have been assigned to talk about
racing to the
children as part of
orientation...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am unfamiliar with such tasks, and thus
cannot
simulate a strategy to
successfully complete it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have deduced that you may know the
secrets to
carrying out this function.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I'm not sure if I'll be any help
either...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Okay, why don't you tell me what you
already
have? Imagine I'm one of the
kids.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A test run, you mean. Very well. I will
begin now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...In brief, sturdy footwork and muscular
strength
are important for acceleration.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is all. How was that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm sorry... but it felt a little stiff to
me...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Stiff?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Is this better?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Your smile is cute and all, but
your speech
was the problem, not your
expression!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You should make it more fun and easy to

understand since you're talking to kids...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Why not make a paper
slideshow
using little illustrations?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...A paper play?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I think the kids would have a fun time
listening to
you talk that way.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But I do not have any prior experience
producing
them, nor do I have much
time remaining.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Everything will work out just fine! I'll
pitch in too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You must really want everyone to enjoy
running.
Isn't that why you're serious
about this?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Strictly speaking, I am only following
orders... but
that is also part of it, yes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then let's work hard on this together. I
want our
little friends to have fun
running too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I just know we can make a wonderful
slideshow!
Having a clear goal builds
motivation!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Motivation... Very well. I approve. We
will do this
for the children.
